XML checks public master/law/Ck0 and both casedef/execution gravity0; actual loaded state asserts1040 native IDs,1000soil/40fixed, Xperiodic width.1, original float material n0=.3,rho2100,Mass.21,rhow1000,Kw2e8,kfloat1e-4,dp.01,hfloat.018,FreeSlip bottom, TopKernelBand q0=10000/ramp.01, drain at.01 with fixed grid. retained_input.no_new_seed: No GenCase, XML edits or formal-case changes. The CLI can accept an otherwise identical retained window25 runtime; exact clock/scheduler identity must be captured by its root-owned caller, not inferred from this note. The component never advances those clocks.

lifecycle.actual: Each ComponentScratch sets only the four private model flags before actual SelecDevice/LoadConfig/LoadCaseParticles/VisuConfig/ConfigDomain/ConfigRunMode/InitRunGpu/FreePartsInit/RunCellDivide(true). It verifies the original normal-soil strict-rest p/p0/v/sigma/plastic/J1/theta0 before any manufactured assignment. Five real Interaction_Forces(SymPredictor) calls total, no force replay after scratch release.
lifecycle.manufactured: Only ComponentScratch arrays/source-clock labels are changed, never an actual Run's initial field, a BI4/PART payload or an existing output. No Run, ComputeStep, host ComputeSymplecticPre/Corr or SaveData call. Dedicated initialized CUDA buffers test the pressure-update API without reproducing or advancing integration.
lifecycle.force_scratch: Read actual rate/Ace/LoadAce/raw band/C while live, then real PosInteraction_Forces and pointer-release checks. No second Normalize call after finished force.

closed_affine.natural: One initial actual force at t0 must have strict soil Ace/theta/pdot0 and exactly10 actual top FSType2/3 receivers. Actual GPU C/normal/wall fits are retained.
closed_affine.input_assignment: Assign p analytically at all actual fluid slots including X images (samez); this is disclosed manufacturing, not a p-copy proof. J stays1/theta0. Invoke actual wall-state and wall-C fits, never write analytic bottom values. Assign Ace only normal soil; each actual complete-rate host call performs native-owner Ace/theta extension, actual wall acceleration and periodic rate extension.
closed_affine.normal_variants: Actual native normals multiplied by1,-1,+2, nine explicit positive complete-rate calls and9000 rate rows. Every variant has500 upper receivers z>.5 and10 top receivers.
closed_affine.independent_reference: Host O(Np^2) all-slot loop, actual double coordinates/support/ALMOSTZERO and separate CPU Wendland factor, actual measured C/wall/Ace. It does not call the GPU rate kernel, production neighbor list, or production gpcorr function. It independently assembles Lp,Lx,Gp,DA and the normal projection. This remains a conditional discrete-operator reference, not an independent mechanical solution or proof that measured C/MLS are accurate.
closed_affine.raw_budget_Pa_s: Unchanged CPU affine contract:64*FLT_EPS*raw +256*DBL_EPS*max(1,abs(B*theta))+1e-6, B=Kw/n(J). raw=B*(abs(theta)+k/gamma*(sumabs(w*dp)+abs-Gpcorr dot abs-Lx+rhow*sumabs(V*dAce dot Gi))); projection absolute terms include abs(N)*[abs(N) dot(abs-Gp+rhow*abs(Ace))/(N dot N)]. Old action retains its own unprojected raw budget. Gamma=rhow*9.80665; do not add body g to finished Ace.
closed_affine.gates: All1000 actual rates each call within independent original raw budget; normal flip/scale difference<=max(original baseline/current budgets). Upper ideal pressure gradients and compatible/tangential zero rates checked within original propagation budget. Unmasked/compatible old action unchanged within max old/new budgets. Each incompatible-normal variant needs actual-old signal>100*max(original old/new budgets); do not tune fields,100 or envelopes if weak.
closed_affine.negative_normals: From the already accepted last positive scratch, change just one real top normal to zero or NaN. Only JException matching ::ComputeDynamicPorePressureRateGpu) and its exact valid-periodic-owner/finite-saturated-rate message is accepted. Arbitrary exceptions do not pass. Named bytes/cache restored after each probe.

drain_and_owner.pressure_API: Four actual cusph::UpdatePorePressureSymplectic calls: half-dt/full-dt crossed with inactive/active drain. Separate valid preGeometry/corrGeometry device buffers contain actual initial coordinates; old p=7/rate=3/result sentinel. Independently require exact float old+dt*rate away from constrained fluid, fixed oldp unchanged, and active FSType2/3 fluid p0 despite oldp7. These buffers do NOT establish that host Pre uses PosxyPreg or Corr is after position write; source review and real trajectory own those facts.
drain_and_owner.actual_host_projection: Explicit source-clock label TimeStep=tD in ComponentScratch, not elapsed integration. Initialize normal fluid p7/image p sentinel and rate3/theta.125, then actual ApplyFreeSurfacePorePressure. Exactly10 top native p/rate0, J unchanged/theta still.125; nonempty periodic pressure owner bytes exact after the real host refresh. Actual complete-rate host call keeps drained native rate0 and refreshes periodic rate/Ace/theta/C; all soil rates finite. Restore clock and named state.
drain_and_owner.owner_kernel_positive: On independent allocated pressure/map/invalid buffers, actual CalcRidp must equal independent normal-ID owner lookup. Actual ExtendDynamicPorePeriodic with its pressure parameter must overwrite nonempty image sentinels with native ID-labelled p.
drain_and_owner.owner_kernel_negative: Point one image ID's map entry at a real fixed native slot. The same actual extension kernel must report exactly the first affected image index via invalid; this is explicitly a device invalid-index API rejection, not a claimed JException or a forged ownership failure in actual Run. Dedicated buffers are RAII-freed; production owner map and IDs are never corrupted.
drain_and_owner.not_covered: No fixed-grid roundoff event-bracket test, strip-footprint geometry discrimination, host Pre/Corr ordering test, actual restart, time integration or saved p/rate metadata proof. TopKernelBand has no strip exemption.

same_stage_load.manufactured_inputs: At actual initial fixed geometry assign J to all actual fluid slots, including X images (not a J-copy proof); normalsoil p/p0/v/sigma/plastic remain original strict0 and legacyrho2100. Capture normal-ID/code/cell/position/velocity/sigma/plastic/p/p0/J bytes and require actual force not change them. Read finished same-stage force before release; no constitutive trajectory interpretation.
same_stage_load.reference: Independent scalar mref=V0*(rho0-rhow+rhow*J), also evaluate n,V,rho and check rhoV versus mref within retained5e-13relative. Normalsoil-only weighted sums exclude fixed/images. Retain target=sum over actual upward top FSType2/3 of MassFluid*(-float(q/(rho0*dp))), independently compare -q*.1 (q5000 gives-500N under the retained2D unit-depth convention). Actual band uses z>zmax-KernelSize and actual nonempty counts, not guessed band width/count.
same_stage_load.budget_N: Exactly CPU load contract:64*FLT_EPS*sum(abs(m*a))+256*DBL_EPS*max(1,abs(retained_target))+1e-6 for rhoV*LoadAce and separately rhoV*finishedAce. Both target and analytic qA0 must fit; float replacement order is preserved, no requirement Ace equals LoadAce0ULP. Natural clock0 raw/load/Ace/rate strictly0.
same_stage_load.negative: For both non-J1 fields, descriptive incorrect sum(MassFluid*finishedLoadAce_z) must differ from retained target by>100*max(loadBudget,forceBudget). This is a declared wrong-weight reduction on measured actual output, not a modified-solver execution. Weak signal rejects without field/budget tuning.
